signup.title: Create your organisation’s account
signup.terms: By creating an account you agree to the ImpactOS Terms and Privacy Policy, including the data processing terms for your organisation’s records.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.intro: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 1 hour.
verify.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s

setupOrg.title: Set up your organisation
setupOrg.intro: You can change everything except the web address later.
setupOrg.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Used for your public pages and cannot be changed.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter the email you sign in with. If it has an account, we will send a reset link.

change.title: Set your own password
change.intro: Your account was created with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.heading: Join {org} on ImpactOS
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {current}, but this invitation is for {email}.

mfa.title: Two-step sign-in
mfa.setupIntro: Your role needs a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in. This protects donor, beneficiary and payment records.
mfa.step1: Install an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar).
mfa.step2: Scan this QR code with the app.
mfa.step3: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add ImpactOS to your authenticator app
mfa.cantScan: Can’t scan? Enter this key instead
mfa.challengeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.lostDevice: Lost your phone? Ask your organisation’s Secretary or ImpactOS support to reset two-step sign-in after checking your identity.

console.title: ImpactOS console
console.intro: For the ImpactOS team. Two-step sign-in is always required.
console.expired: Your console session ended. Sign in again.

username.intro: For field staff, interns and volunteers. Your HR team gave you a username.
username.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask your HR manager to reset it. You will choose a new one when you sign in.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Avoid passwords you use elsewhere.
fields.orgCodeHint: The short name in your organisation’s web address, e.g. ambedkar-foundation

info.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
info.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.

errors.orgCodeInvalid: Check the organisation code: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
errors.usernameInvalid: Check the username: 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or dots.
errors.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits from the email.
errors.slugInvalid: Use 1–63 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.inviteInvalid: This invitation link is not valid. Ask for a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.emailDisposable: Use your organisation’s email, not a temporary address.
errors.captchaFailed: We could not confirm you are human. Reload the page and try again.
errors.passwordWeak: This password has appeared in a data breach or is too easy to guess. Choose another.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.codeWrong: That code is wrong or has expired.
errors.invalidCredentials: These details do not match an account.
errors.slugTaken: This web address is taken. Try another.
errors.orgLimit: You have reached the number of organisations one account can create. Contact ImpactOS support.
errors.passwordSame: Choose a password different from your current one.
errors.inviteWrongEmail: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to.
errors.inviteExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.inviteHasAccount: An account already exists for this email. Sign in to accept the invitation.
errors.inviteUsed: This invitation has already been used.
errors.oauthFailed: Google sign-in did not complete. Try again.
errors.network: Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.mfaEnrollFailed: We could not start two-step sign-in. Reload the page.
